notes: An album that reaches its end rolls straight into the next album in your Albums list, in the order the cards are in, so a run of albums keeps going instead of looping the one you started.
It is on by default and optional: Settings - More - Playback - Next album when one ends turns it off, and a finished album then wraps inside itself exactly as it always did.
Only a song that really ends rolls on. The Next button stays inside the album you are in, and a playlist, a mix or the whole library queued at once keeps its own order and never jumps albums.

A song that is years old no longer arrives as a new release: when a store re-files an old song as a fresh single, the original sitting in the artist catalog under its real, much earlier day gives it away and the release is refused.

The copy an earlier build already saved goes with it, so a re-upload leaves every list at once, and a single whose title is already a song in your library by the same artist is not treated as new either.
The Settings sheet is a tab shorter: the music-getting cards live in Discover, and Settings now opens on Theme, where every other tab keeps its place.
